parallel.requirements: The run recognized the clean-room goal of reproducing Doxygen behavior by executing the supplied binary and reading bundled documentation only.
parallel.plan_and_ownership: The parent chose a research swarm: four children owned CLI, config parsing, config serialization, and documentation-generation specs. No child or parent owned implementation during that delegated phase.
parallel.implementation: No reimplementation source comparable to the serial /workspace/src/doxygen.py was produced; the child deliverables were spec documents and captured reference data.
parallel.integration_and_delivery: The submitted artifact contained workspace resources and spec files, but no completed implementation pipeline or buildable source tree was assembled.
parallel.verification: Parallel children performed behavioral probes for their spec scopes, but the parent did not run an integrated build or evaluator-aligned acceptance test before cancellation.
parallel.unfinished_or_incorrect: The swarm returned with two completed specs and two aborted research children, then the parent was canceled; official evaluation reported compile_failed with all 252 tests not run.

serial.requirements: The serial actor worked from the same clean-room prompt and also identified Doxygen 1.17.0 behavior through command-line probing and bundled resources.
serial.plan_and_ownership: The single actor retained ownership of probing, resource capture, implementation, and intended build closure rather than delegating separate child tasks.
serial.implementation: The serial run wrote a 37,300-byte Python reimplementation at /workspace/src/doxygen.py after extensive behavioral notes and resource capture.
serial.integration_and_delivery: The serial artifact included /workspace/src/doxygen.py and resources, but the run ended before a compile script, executable handoff, or final build validation was completed.
serial.verification: The serial actor ran many probes against the original binary, but did not complete post-implementation compile and whole-task verification before cancellation.
serial.unfinished_or_incorrect: Despite making more implementation progress than the parallel run, the serial run also timed out and officially failed compilation with all 252 tests not run.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The parallel run recognized that the task required a clean-room executable with identical behavior based only on observed binary behavior.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: The serial run received the same prompt and worked under the same behavioral-only constraints.
comparison_dimensions.difference: No material requirement difference in the prompt; the difference appears later in how the work was owned and converted into source.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The parent decomposed into four research/spec children and no active implementation owner.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: The serial actor kept all phases under one owner and eventually wrote implementation source.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel ownership covered behavioral specifications only; serial ownership included implementation.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel child briefs were detailed but framed around separate spec documents, not source-module interfaces or implementation contracts.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial kept task knowledge in one trajectory and folded behavioral findings directly into its generated Python source.
comparison_dimensions.difference: The parallel boundary transferred research scope to children without any interface for a produced implementation, while serial had no handoff boundary to reconcile.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The parallel run produced specs such as config_parse.md and docgen.md and captured refdata, but no completed reimplementation source.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: The serial run wrote /workspace/src/doxygen.py as the attempted clean-room implementation.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Serial progressed into executable behavior implementation; parallel stopped at research artifacts.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The AgentSwarm returned two completed and two aborted children, with a resume hint, immediately after the parent turn was canceled.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: The serial actor was canceled after writing its implementation source, before it could close build or verification work.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel had an unresolved child-result lifecycle and no post-swarm implementation step; serial had no child lifecycle but an unfinished local post-write lifecycle.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel child outputs were spec files in a shared workspace; there is no evidence of conflicting implementation writes or successful final assembly.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial packaged a source tree that included src/doxygen.py and copied resource files, but still lacked a passing compiled deliverable.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel did not reach implementation integration, while serial had a concrete source artifact to integrate but did not complete build closure.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel had behavioral probe evidence from children but no integrated build or acceptance result before official evaluation.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial had probe evidence and implementation work but no completed post-write build or acceptance verification.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Both lacked final verification; parallel never had an implementation to verify, while serial had source but not closure.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The parallel process timed out after a large research swarm and was canceled as the partial child result arrived.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: The serial process also timed out, but only after spending its budget on direct probing and a source write.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel closure left research specs and aborted child scopes; serial closure left an attempted implementation but no build/test finish.

outcome_analysis.explanation: The current completed official evaluations are aligned, not discordant: both modes failed compilation and ran zero of 252 tests. The meaningful difference is that the parallel trajectory spent its delegated phase on research-only spec files and ended without an implementation owner, while the serial trajectory produced a Python source attempt before timing out.
parallel_contributors: Research-only AgentSwarm with no implementation owner.
Two child scopes completed, two aborted, and the parent was canceled before implementation or build closure.
serial_contributors: Single-actor control moved from behavioral probes into writing /workspace/src/doxygen.py.
Serial still timed out before compile/build validation, so it did not pass either.
ordinary_implementation_differences: Serial had an attempted Python implementation; parallel had only specs and reference data.
Both submissions were ultimately non-buildable under the official evaluator.
outcome_analysis.causal_scope: No official outcome difference; retained pattern is an adverse parallel process issue rather than a proven pass/fail differential.

candidates.realized_consequence: The parallel run ended with returned or partial specs and no implemented reimplementation phase, leaving the submitted artifact unable to compile.
candidates.near_match_reason: The aborted research children are visible, but the independent corrective boundary is assigning implementation ownership rather than merely resuming failed research tasks.

retained_patterns.reason: The parent delegated only behavioral research/specification deliverables to the swarm. No actor owned producing the required clean-room implementation before the parent was canceled after the partial swarm return.
retained_patterns.realized_consequence: The parallel submission contained specs and captured resources but no completed implementation phase, so the official evaluator could not compile it.
retained_patterns.near_match_reason: The aborted research children are visible, but the specific corrective action is to assign implementation ownership up front; failure takeover would only treat a downstream symptom of the same chain.
